summary: Added visible Cancel while a request runs; Retry after cancellation, errors, partial/unavailable searches.

Generation and AbortSignal checks prevent stale locate/search/ingest/geographic/buildScene resolutions from publishing UI results or reaching later onScene calls; cancellation and destroy invalidate old pickers/play actions.
Preserved native form submission (including Enter); blocks duplicate busy submissions, preserves query text, and releases busy controls only for the current request.
Geography-only build_scene requests call the injected geographic builder, never incident ingestion or incident search.
Out-of-AOI candidates render Outside UAE AOI — external context only; removed override and Play for refusals, with optional external-context callback.
Successful scenes show concise generated/ready copy and incident-composer-play; incident scene ingestion, dedupe reuse, source-search details, and mobile stack measurements remain supported.
Partial search chip is partial, unavailable is error; errors/cancellation mark the active stage rather than claiming completion.

createIncidentComposer_options: createGeographicScene: async ({candidate, extraction, text, signal}) => scene; required for geography-only build_scene; no fallback to fabricated incidents.
onExternal?: async ({candidate, extraction, text, signal}) => void; called for AOI refusals, not a playable scene.
onScene existing payload preserved, with extraction, text, signal, generation, source added; source is geographic or incident, override is always false; geographic incident and ingest are null.
onLocated existing payload preserved with text and signal added.
buildScene receives existing incidents argument and optional second {signal}; awaits sync or async return.
returned_api: state.generation: monotonically increasing request identity added
api_changes.parser_compatibility: Uses intent=build_scene with hasEventDescription/describesEvent metadata when present; falls back to existing incident event vocabulary. Merges local parser metadata with locate extraction. Agent 3 owns query.js; no edits made there.

coverage: cancelled search vs newer busy generation

tests: out-of-AOI: explicit reason shown, "Add anyway (override)" offered, override ingests with override:true
failures.reason: Existing test explicitly requires Add anyway (override), which this task explicitly removes. Tests were not edited.

failures.detail: rg was not installed; used grep/find. node_modules/.bin/prettier symlink absent; invoked installed prettier through node successfully.

limitations: No live browser was provisioned; native Enter behavior is covered by preserving the form submit/default event path and unit assertions, not a browser-driven keypress.

Callbacks must honour their supplied AbortSignal before their own external side effects. Composer guards its own state and does not invoke downstream callbacks after a cancelled await; it cannot undo a server ingest or external callback side effect already performed before cancellation.
Coordinator still needs to supply createGeographicScene and handle geographic onScene integration; no other repository files were edited.
